summary: Send QA V3 evidence with a compact deterministic document/page/scope relation pack while removing repeated per-row file and locator metadata.
decision_refs: The existing selector already retains document, page, locator and storage order, so no new graph database or semantic inference is required.
Exact source text and E aliases remain unchanged; source_groups is navigation metadata and cannot support a claim or calculation by itself.
On the frozen fixed-15 input, the grouped shape reduced serialized input metadata for every question by 2,325 to 9,404 bytes without a model call.
Historical verification note: deterministic page grouping and original source-order restoration
Historical verification note: source-group coverage without source-text duplication
Historical verification note: QA V3 MockTransport request and recovery regression
Historical verification note: frozen fixed-15 zero-call serialized-input measurement
Historical verification note: full Python, localization, spec, change and bundle gates
approval_evidence: The user explicitly requested implementation of relational file context in model input.
known_limitations: The first relation pack exposes only deterministic containment and source order; it does not infer table-header, exception, supersession or cross-document semantic edges.
Offline input reduction and contract tests do not establish live Flash or Pro answer-quality improvement.
A paid C1/C3/C5 smoke remains a separate explicit validation step.
